title: Two police officers among seven killed in wrong-way car crash
description: PC Matthew Blades and PC Tom Clough died after a car driving the wrong way down the A66 near Middlesbrough collided with a police vehicle.

title: Video appears to show police chase minutes before fatal A66 crash
description: Several police vehicles are seen chasing a car just three minutes before the crash on the A66 near Middlesbrough.

title: Struggling households need more help with bills, energy industry says
description: Industry body Energy UK says the current support for households most in need does not go far enough.
